fields: Records(record type, source id/version/hash, disposition, optional successor id, rationale)
Commitments(id, description, owner, due date, source engagement/record/version/hash)

state.sourceRule: TypeIIPlan proposal validates exact frozen Type I baseline, outcome, system description, approved controls/owners, every current finding, all carry-forward sources. ProgramRolloverContent is not a complete TypeIIPlanContent and lacks source Type I baseline IDs, system description, controls and complete plan content.

choice.instructions: How should ProgramRolloverExecutionProcess handle the fact that approved rollover content is not sufficient to deterministically construct a valid TypeIIPlanContent?

criteria.explicit_human_authored_successor_plan: After exact rollover execution claim, require an authorized actor to submit a complete TypeIIPlanContent that passes TypeIIPlan owner source validation. Freeze exact content in private process state, require every rollover disposition/commitment to have an explicit mapped or intentionally excluded outcome, then preserve independent plan review and executive approval. Do not invent derived values.
criteria.add_complete_plan_to_rollover: Expand rollover proposal itself to include every exact TypeIIPlanContent field and make it the source authority for the next plan.
criteria.automatic_mapping: Derive the missing source snapshot, system description, controls and findings from rollover records using implicit defaults.
criteria.business_policy_required: Available facts do not establish which completion approach is intended.

mapping.instructions: Does a complete source-backed deterministic mapping currently exist from ProgramRolloverContent into TypeIIPlanContent?

criteria.true: Every target field and carry-forward identity/disposition can be derived uniquely from approved source content.
criteria.false: The target has material fields/sources that are not supplied or uniquely derivable.

noomission.instructions: What is the safe rule for rollover records and commitments when preparing the successor plan?

criteria.exhaustive_mapping: Every approved item must be explicitly mapped to an exact plan input, carried finding/gap, acknowledgement or required change, or be explicitly dispositioned as intentionally not represented; reject omissions and hash the complete mapping.
criteria.best_effort: Carry matching records and ignore nonmatching categories.
